Official site confirms: 13 faculties, 80+ English-taught programs, founded 1538, dormitories + private flats, Stipendium Hungaricum + Erasmus scholarships. Official bachelor-programs page lists Business Administration and Management BSc, Commerce and Marketing BSc, Computer Science BSc, Computer Science Engineering BSc, Business Informatics BSc, Mechanical/Electrical/Civil/Chemical/Mechatronics/Vehicle/Environmental Engineering BSc, Engineering Management BSc, Agricultural Engineering BSc, Psychology BA, English and American Studies BA, Biology/Biotechnology/Physics/Mathematics BSc, Nursing and Patient Care BSc, Classical Performing Arts (Music) BA — all matching catalog. Medicine/Dentistry/Pharmacy confirmed as flagship English programs. Tuition amounts not in official HTML (PDF-only); WebSearch corroborated Medicine order-of-magnitude (~USD 16,900). Official states 8 campuses vs 4 listed. Scholarships and accommodation descriptions consistent with official content. Real-stat note: official cites ~34,000 students / 7,700 international / 140 countries vs catalog's ~30,000 / ~6,000 / 100+ — catalog figures are conservative but slightly stale, not wrong.
